nodes.label: Auth Extensions (reset password, email verify, 2FA)
nodes.rationale: Reset tokens stored hashed (revocable), 2FA opt-in via two_factor_confirmed_at so existing login unaffected, recovery codes bcrypt-hashed.

nodes.label: Segmented Database Configuration
nodes.rationale: DB_HOST/PORT/NAME/USER/PASSWORD split for flexibility; SKIP_DB_INIT disables auto table creation in favor of Alembic.

nodes.label: Commande Refund Workflow
nodes.rationale: refund_idempotency_key prevents double refunds; partial and full refunds with reverse stock movements.

nodes.label: Python 3.13 Requirement
nodes.rationale: Python 3.14 causes incompatibilities with SQLAlchemy versions.

nodes.label: P0 Alembic Migration 20260925_1700
nodes.rationale: Single reversible migration adding only nullable columns to minimize production risk.

nodes.label: Reservation & Waitlist System
nodes.rationale: TableStatut.RESERVEE existed but unused; adds Reservation, ReservationGuest, WaitlistEntry with conflict checks via SERIALIZABLE/EXCLUDE USING gist and auto-promotion.

nodes.label: StaffRole (granular staff permissions)
nodes.rationale: Only 3 base roles (admin|pos|restaurant) exist; per-establishment roles (serveur, caissier, chef, manager, livreur) on RestaurantMember with require_staff_role guard.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL RLS Tenant Isolation Policies
nodes.rationale: Policies use app_current_user_id(), app_current_tenant_id(), app_is_platform_admin() session functions to isolate each restaurant's rows.

nodes.label: Restaurant POS Platforms (Toast, Square, Lightspeed, Clover)
nodes.norm_label: restaurant pos platforms (toast, square, lightspeed, clover)

nodes.label: Automatic Stock Deduction on Commande
nodes.rationale: Must be transactional with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on StockComposant to avoid negative stock and deadlocks.

nodes.label: PlatComposant BOM (Bill of Materials)
nodes.rationale: Plat had no link to Composant so recipes and stock deduction for standard dishes were impossible.

nodes.label: Marinade MVP Maturity Assessment
nodes.rationale: Rated prototype 1/10 production readiness; 7% of SaaS billing standards, 20% of restaurant standards.

nodes.label: Composable Catalog (Composant -> Combinaison)
nodes.rationale: Restaurants selling customizable meals (base, sauce, protein) need per-component availability and pricing.

nodes.label: Stock Reservation Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Stock reserved on item add, consumed on payment, released on cancel; row locking prevents concurrent over-reservation. disponible = quantite - reservee.

nodes.label: Server-side Pricing (anti-fraud)
nodes.rationale: Unit price = combinaison price + supplements, computed server-side; client prix_unitaire ignored to prevent fraud.

nodes.label: SaaS Billing Platforms (Stripe, Chargebee, Recurly, Zuora)
nodes.norm_label: saas billing platforms (stripe, chargebee, recurly, zuora)

nodes.label: Francophone Africa Restaurant Niche Strategy
nodes.rationale: Underserved by US giants; FCFA, French, mobile-first, SMS-first; recommended final strategy validated with 5-10 pilots.

nodes.label: Dual Order Model (Commande vs RosOrder)
nodes.rationale: Two order models coexist without coordination; RosOrder (sessions, production tickets, invoices, idempotence) is the preferred path, Commande gets only stock deduction and refunds for parity.

nodes.label: Commande Formal Deprecation
nodes.rationale: Backward compatibility: do not delete Commande; mark routes deprecated=True, log DeprecationWarning, add X-Deprecated-Endpoint: use-ros-orders header.

nodes.label: Restaurant Subscription Niche (PizzaBox AI, Possier, Menutro, Ressto)
nodes.norm_label: restaurant subscription niche (pizzabox ai, possier, menutro, ressto)

nodes.label: config_jsonb Advanced Restaurant Configuration
nodes.rationale: JSONB fields (config_jsonb, attributs_jsonb) allow per-restaurant customization without schema changes.
